items.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Expands SpaceX Stake to $69 Billion and Deepens AI Ties
items.summary: Alphabet (NasdaqGS: GOOGL) has expanded its SpaceX stake by nearly 4 million additional shares, lifting the holding’s value to about US$69b. The position has grown from an original US$900m investment, reflecting a very large increase in the implied equity value. Alphabet has agreed to pay SpaceX monthly for Nvidia GPU access that will support the Gemini Enterprise AI platform.
